content: शापः [शप्-घञ्] .²1 A curse, an imprecation, anathema; शापेनास्तंगमितमहिमा वर्षभोग्येण भर्तुः <ls>Me. 1</ls>, <ls n="Me.">92</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 78</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 56</ls>, <ls n="R. 5.">59</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 14</ls>. .²2 An oath, asseveration. .²3 Abuse, calumny. .²4 An interdiction, a ban. .²5 Trouble, disturbance (उपद्रव); मुक्तशापं वनं तच्च तस्मिन्नेव तदाहनि <ls>Rām. 1. 26. 35</ls>.
